title: Fatou lower bound for integrals from the liminf inequality on bounded open sets
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ and μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)). Assume μ(G) ≤ liminf_j μ_j(G) (in [0, ∞]) for every bounded open set G ⊆ ℝ^P. Then for every continuous g : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and g(x) ≥ 0 for all x, ∫⁻ ofReal(g) dμ ≤ liminf_j ∫⁻ ofReal(g) dμ_j, where ∫⁻ is the lower Lebesgue integral with values in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → Bornology.IsBounded G → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ ≤ liminf (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂(μs j)) atTop
